"Awefully Quiet is an album that has been a long time in the making. Some of the songs date back to 2017 when I passed them up for my previous album. Some of the others are songs I wrote and would play with a buddy of mine and may have been a part of another more extensive album but which ultimately didn't come to fruition. The motive behind Awefully Quiet comes from the expression of an otherwise reserved source. That part of a conversation when the other person stops talking and states "you've been awefully quiet". The choice of the word 'awefully' a deliberate indication that your lack of a statement is akin to a negative or hostile one. When the world around you seems to be in argument or conflict and your lack of participation in that argument is so unbearable to them that they prod your silence and beckon for an answer. This album is a retort. Many of my songs and lyrics come from notes jotted down in my phone, random snippets and fleeting thoughts inspired by things I come across. Sometimes anxieties and frustrations but also moments of joy and carefree abandon."
